sentences.text: Karen Lucille Hale -LRB- born June 14 , 1989 -RRB- is an American actress and singer .	actress	actress	singer	singer
Earlier in her career , she was sometimes credited as Lucy Kate Hale .
Hale first came to prominence as one of the five winners of the reality show American Juniors , a children 's spin off of American Idol .	American Juniors	American Juniors	American Idol	American Idol

She is best known for her role as Aria Montgomery on the Freeform series Pretty Little Liars , which won her a People 's Choice Award for Favorite Cable TV Actress in 2014 .	Pretty Little Liars	Pretty Little Liars	Aria Montgomery	Aria Montgomery	Freeform	Freeform (TV channel)
The same year , she released her debut studio album , Road Between .	Road Between	Road Between
